Daily helpful news for passengers
With that in mind
Travel notice for animal passengers

Travelers should review the latest steps for bringing an animal before departure. The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways provides clear guidance from booking through pickup so that each journey is handled with care and order.

Please keep travel papers ready and follow the instructions given by the passenger coordinator. <<FACT F060>> Staff members will help you prepare the crate, confirm the route, and note any special care needed for the animal during the trip.

If you are traveling with a pet, early contact with the desk helps reduce delays and prevents avoidable confusion at check-in. The records team will log the request, share the required notes, and point out what to bring on the travel day.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure for full guidance and support.
